title: Final Stock
core_verb: Strike the CPU opponent to increase its knockback and launch it beyond the stage boundary.
fantasy: A mascot-style fighter duel on a single floating platform surrounded by open space.
fail_state: Your fighter crosses the blast boundary, reducing your single stock to zero.
win_state: The CPU opponent crosses the blast boundary, reducing its single stock to zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: CPU-generated attack hitbox; contact increases your damage and knockback.
Out-of-bounds volume surrounding the platform; crossing it removes one stock from the fighter that entered it.
Goal target; strike and launch this fighter across the blast boundary to remove its final stock and win.

notes: The multiplayer party brawl is reduced to one player-controlled fighter versus one CPU opponent on a single-platform stage, with one stock each; the first fighter knocked beyond the blast boundary loses.

scene.description: A single flat stone platform suspended in open sky, clouds drifting far below. The platform is the whole arena, and faint coloured blast boundary lines mark the edges past which a fighter is out. Sparse by design: nothing on the platform but the fighters.
